projects.title: Featured Projects & Case Studies
projects.subtitle: Mission-critical architectures, large-scale migrations, and high-concurrency systems

case1.title: Production MCP Diagnostic Server
case1.problem: Debugging multi-channel booking anomalies across 6 OTAs required manual multi-database log queries across gigabytes of data, consuming 15 to 60 minutes per incident.
case1.solution: Designed a dedicated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with hexagonal architecture, granting AI assistants read-only access to MongoDB and SQL Server to reconstruct timelines automatically via natural language.
case1.impact: Reduced mean time to investigation from 60 minutes to under 30 seconds.

case2.title: Massive Expedia Channel PRO Migration Tool
case2.problem: Mandatory migration of enterprise holiday rental accounts from legacy Expedia API to modern Channel PRO without booking interruption or availability downtime.
case2.solution: Architected a batch processing migration orchestrator with progress telemetry, automated verification checkpoints, instant rollback safety, and Excel audit reporting.
case2.impact: Successfully migrated 211 companies in 11 days (1,664 actions) with zero recorded errors.

case3.title: Real-time OTA Inventory Synchronization Engine
case3.problem: Preventing overbooking and rate desynchronization across millions of daily transactions with Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia, and Vrbo.
case3.solution: Decoupled connectivity microservices into an event-driven architecture using TypeScript/Node.js, AWS SQS queuing, and real-time inventory parity algorithms compliant with PCI-DSS.
case3.impact: Drastic reduction in overbooking occurrences and rock-solid partner API stability.

case4.title: High-Throughput E-Commerce Big Data Ingestion
case4.problem: Integrating heterogeneous real-time transactional feeds, clickstream data, inventory levels, and marketing telemetry at massive scale.
case4.solution: Architected hybrid streaming and batch ingestion topology utilizing Apache Kafka as high-throughput messaging backbone and scalable Cloud Data Lake storage.
case4.impact: Sub-second event streaming ingestion with unified analytics readiness.
